name: Heal
description: A basic healing spell that restores health to an ally.

name: Flash Heal
description: A fast but expensive heal for emergencies.

name: Renew
description: Place a heal over time effect on an ally.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: Heal all nearby party members.

name: Power Word: Shield
description: Shield an ally, absorbing damage.

name: Smite
description: Smite an enemy with holy fire.

name: Holy Fire
description: Blast an enemy with holy fire that burns over time.

name: Shadow Word: Pain
description: Afflict the enemy with shadow damage over time.

name: Mind Blast
description: Blast the enemy mind with shadow energy.

name: Resurrection
description: Bring a fallen ally back to life.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Remove a magical effect from friend or foe.

name: Mass Dispel
description: Dispel magic effects from all nearby targets.

name: Psychic Scream
description: Cause nearby enemies to flee in fear.

name: Fade
description: Fade into the shadows, reducing threat.

name: Guardian Spirit
description: Spirit watches over ally, preventing death once.

name: Divine Hymn
description: Channel a hymn that heals all nearby allies.

name: Pain Suppression
description: Reduce all damage taken by an ally significantly.

name: Leap of Faith
description: Pull an ally to your location.

name: Holy Word: Serenity
description: A powerful single-target heal with long cooldown.

name: Spirit of Redemption
description: Upon death, become a spirit and heal freely for a time.
